lookback_notes: NOT_FOUND — the protocol's Area 15 entry states no observation or look-back window. It states only that if the requested personnel record is not available for review, claims for all dates of service will be disallowed. (A 7-day look-back appears elsewhere in the document, at Area 30 for the PRI, but that is a different audit area and does not apply to Area 15.)

federal_coding_rules.rule: If the requested personnel record for the individual providing service is not available for review, claims for all dates of service will be disallowed.

source.quote: If the requested personnel record for the individual providing service is not available for review, claims for all dates of service will be disallowed.

federal.criterion: A personnel record must exist and be available for review, upon request, for the individual who provided the service on the claim; absence of the requested record results in disallowance of claims for all dates of service.

source.quote: If the requested personnel record for the individual providing service is not available for review, claims for all dates of service will be disallowed.

federal.notes: The protocol states only availability of the requested personnel record; it does not enumerate the required contents of the personnel record within Area 15.

case_mix_relevance.notes: The Area 15 entry does not tie the personnel record to any payment or case-mix classification. (Rate/RUG-related provisions appear in separate audit areas, e.g. Areas 12 and 13, not in Area 15.)
